title: Technician II Harvest and Postharvest Deviation Log
description: A lot-linked deviation record for harvest and postharvest observations, environmental and handling evidence, product-status controls, investigation, escalation, and disposition ownership.
instructions: Record lot identity, process stage, time, location, and product status before documenting the deviation.
Preserve original temperature, humidity, water-activity, handling, sanitation, packaging, or storage evidence when available.
Document immediate authorized containment separately from root-cause hypotheses.
Identify the role responsible for investigation, release, rework, hold, rejection, or other disposition decisions.
limitations: This template does not define universal drying, curing, storage, water-activity, microbial, or disposition limits.
Product release and disposition remain subject to applicable law, testing requirements, quality procedures, and authorized personnel.
publicationNote: Owner-approved academic learner support. Not a regulated record, facility SOP, assessor score sheet, or professional credential issuance instrument.
